title: Albert's father's name, Dejan, and the band's swing tempo
summary: Albert's father's name was Fernand; Dejan started with the big band and later went into an asylum; the rhythm section's tempo made the band, called America's greatest swing band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did I ever get your father's name? Ferdinand.
Ferdinand, I thought I had. But it's spelled F-U-R-N-E-N-D, Fernand. He wanted to make the distinction between the Ferdinand and Fernand.
I think we just about got the rhythm there except, well, Ferdinand and Dajon.
Yeah, no. Did he continue playing?
No, you know, Dajon went into the insane asylum. Yeah. And that's why he died.
Yeah. But that was from your band.
Oh, he started here with my big band. And he left, I sent him home. Must have been tracking. Yes, it was.
It was such a good rhythm section.
It was great. That's what made the band so great. It had a set, a tempo that nobody there ever heard. The tempo was the thing that got my band over.
What kind of a tempo do you use?
Well, we call it America's greatest swing metal.
